package.description: Local headless HTML-to-video renderer for AI agents. Shots are plain web pages driven by render(t); includes determinism checks, cut-aware motion blur, and a 3D layer with accumulated depth of field.

en-US.description: Local headless HTML-to-video renderer for AI agents. Shots are plain web pages driven by render(t); includes determinism checks, cut-aware motion blur, and a 3D layer with accumulated depth of field.
en-US.longDescription:
A local, headless HTML video renderer for AI agents. A shot is an ordinary web page: the page implements render(t), and the image depends only on time t. Multiplane captures frames with headless Chromium, applies post-processing such as supersampling, motion blur, and film grain, encodes video with FFmpeg, and checks whether a shot is deterministic.
The name comes from Disney's multiplane camera: flat artwork placed at different depths, photographed frame by frame with real depth of field. Here, this corresponds to layered web content, a 3D card layer, and accumulated depth of field.

Features
- No new framework to learn. Shots use HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, which agents are well suited to write.
- Lint before rendering. lint runs without a browser in under a second. It flags wall-clock time, random numbers, CSS animations, remote resources, and other patterns that break determinism, with file, line, and column locations. Rendering commands run it automatically before starting.
- Verifiable. verify renders the same frames out of order, after page reloads, and with single and multiple processes, then compares them pixel by pixel. Mismatches include the affected times, regions, and diff images.
- Motion blur respects hard cuts. Each frame uses multiple time samples within the shutter interval, blended in linear light. Images on opposite sides of the shot's declared hard cut times, cuts, are never blurred together.
- 3D layer and accumulated depth of field (optional, multiplane/three): place image cards in 3D space and accumulate multiple samples for real out-of-focus blur, combined with motion blur.
- Machine-readable. All commands support --json and emit an event stream with stable error codes. Each run has its own job directory, supports progress queries, and can be cancelled.
- Stills too. stills writes PNG frames at the times you choose, with the same supersampling, motion blur, depth of field and alpha as video. Use it to check frames, or to produce final images such as covers, posters and illustrations.
- Deterministic. The renderer itself introduces no wall-clock time or unseeded random numbers. The same input in the same environment produces identical pixels, backed by tests.
en-US.name: Multiplane
en-US.releaseNotes:
Two fixes contributed by @fisHarly0: copied job commands keep their encoder and raster settings, and a relative --root no longer splits one project into several on the Jobs page. Both the renderer and the desktop app changed; an npm release follows.
Renderer
- A relative --root no longer splits a project. Jobs started with a relative --root (for example --root .) stored that relative value in their events. The desktop app resolved it against each shot's own directory, so shots in shots/ and other/ showed up as two different projects. The root is now resolved against the working directory when the command starts and stored as an absolute path. Jobs recorded by earlier versions keep their current grouping, because the original working directory was not recorded. Fixes #3 (#5, thanks @fisHarly0).
Desktop app
- Copied commands keep encoder and raster settings. "Copy command" left out --encoder x264 and --raster gpu because they match the built-in defaults. If your saved preferences named a different encoder or raster mode, running the copied command used those instead. Copied commands now always include the raster mode, and the encoder for MP4 renders. Fixes #2 (#4, thanks @fisHarly0).

zh-CN.author: 路北路陈
zh-CN.description: 面向 AI 智能体的本地无头 HTML 转视频渲染器。镜头即由 render(t) 驱动的普通网页；包含确定性检查、镜头切换感知的运动模糊，以及带有累积景深的 3D 图层。
zh-CN.longDescription:
给 AI agent 用的本地无头 HTML 视频渲染器。镜头就是普通网页：页面实现 render(t)，画面只由时间 t 决定；Multiplane 用无头 Chromium 逐帧截图，做超采样、运动模糊、胶片颗粒等后期，用 FFmpeg 合成视频，并能检查镜头是否确定。
名字来自迪士尼的多层摄影台（multiplane camera）：一层层平面画稿放在不同深度、逐帧拍摄、带真实景深。对应这里的多层网页画面、三维卡片层和累积景深。

特点
- 不用学新框架。镜头是 HTML、CSS 和一段 JavaScript，agent 最擅长写的东西。
- 渲染前检查。lint 不开浏览器、不到一秒，指出墙钟时间、随机数、CSS 动画、网络资源等会破坏确定性的写法，定位到文件、行、列；渲染命令启动前会自动先跑。
- 可验证。verify 会乱序、重载页面、单进程和多进程分别渲染同一批帧，逐像素比较；不一致时给出出问题的时刻、区域和差异图。
- 运动模糊不跨硬切。每帧在快门时间内多次采样、按线性光混合；镜头声明的硬切时刻 cuts 两侧的画面不会糊在一起。
- 三维层与累积景深（可选，multiplane/three）：图片卡片进三维空间，多次采样累积出真实的焦外虚化，与运动模糊配合。
- 机器可读。所有命令支持 --json，输出带稳定错误码的事件流；每次运行有独立的作业目录，可查询进度、可取消。
- 也能出静帧。stills 按指定时刻输出 PNG，和视频走同一套超采样、运动模糊、景深和透明通道。可以用来抽帧检查，也可以直接出封面、海报、配图这类高质量静帧。
- 确定性。渲染器自身不引入墙钟时间和未设种子的随机数；同一输入在同一环境下逐像素一致，并由测试保证。
